run_bm_simulate_prior_predictive: run bm.simulate to generate prior predictive samples from random variable queries
run_bm_simulate_posterior_predictive: run bm.simulate with posterior samples to generate posterior predictive distributions
run_single_site_ancestral_metropolis_has: run SingleSiteAncestralMetropolisHastings to infer posterior samples given observed data
run_bm_empirical: run bm.empirical to subsample posterior samples into an empirical distribution
run_bm_simulate_to_inference_data: run bm.simulate and convert results to inference data with posterior and observed_data groups
